_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Both brains see momentum, DXY weakness, and ETF flows fueling a continued climb toward Belief, but the analyst's diverging factors cap conviction at medium rather than high.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes — both call UP toward Belief; analyst is more cautious on conviction due to VIX/gold/stablecoin divergences
next_move.confirmed_if: VIX breaks below 12 and stablecoin_growth crosses above 60 with fed_liquidity rising above 15
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 20 with btc_momentum_30d rolling over below 75 and retail_noise_velocity accelerating above 80
